Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.filter

Enum Class BoundaryReason

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<BoundaryReason>
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.filter.BoundaryReason
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<BoundaryReason>, Constable
public enum BoundaryReason extends Enum<BoundaryReason>
Why a RequestBoundary refused a request.

Enumerated rather than collapsed into a single "forbidden" so the application can render an accurate reason and log an actionable one. Distinguishing missing from mismatched leaks nothing a cross-origin caller does not already know about its own request.

The constant names are wire codes: RequestBoundaryFilter sends them in the RequestBoundaryFilter.REJECTION_HEADER response header and in the rejection body's reason, and page scripts match on them. A name, once shipped, does not change. Each constant notes the status a boundary answers it with; the status travels on the BoundaryResult, not on this enum.

    Trusted forwarding is on and the forwarded proto was not http or https.

    ORIGIN_MISSING
